title: The product's model through the harness suite for the first time: what Claude as the Home agent got wrong, and the fixes
request: The owner: a $20 budget to run the test cases live and see how the system's agents and agent teams work, find the bugs and fix them.
spec: CLAUDE.md (make harness-eval, the live runs' rules), docs/guides/PHASE8_KNOWLEDGE_CARDS_RECIPES_PLAN.md status
plan: Run every model path once, then the harness suite live with a cap, keeping every record.
Read each failure from its kept draft: the questions, the answers, the understanding, the built solution.
Fix the cause in the product where the product is wrong, in the written person where the harness is; test each first.
Rerun the failed cases live, then the whole suite live, within the budget.

decisions.decision: The code makes sure the plan's own questions are asked before a build, whatever the model does.
decisions.why: Deterministic code owns what changes the split (rule 5); a model may choose the order and the words, never to skip who could commit a fraud.

decisions.decision: A field the meet check blocks on (the unit) and one that groups the folds (the entity) are never written by a model from its own reading.
decisions.why: A model's paraphrase made an order the entity and a biker the unit: one grouped nothing, the other blocked the build.

decisions.decision: The harness's code gate reads the latest run on the rules; a live run is a measurement of a model.
decisions.why: Whether a model may serve is already gated by passed_with; a live measurement failing must not stand for the code, nor a passing rules run for the model.

decisions.decision: The written person learns the card's family question; the expected questions and their order stay as written.
decisions.why: The person was answering the outcome to a question about the family (a harness fault); the cases' expectations are never weakened to make a model pass.

change: dclab_rnd.draft.chat (OPTIONAL, ANSWER_ONLY, RULES_READ, WORDS_KEPT, LEAVE_TO_BUILD, counted, replied_to, edited, close_optional; ask, record, model_turn and the guard); dclab_core.coordinator (Facts.open_field, the ask step) and its host; dclab_rnd.draft.api (_entity_column never a row's own key); the journeys' written person; the regression harness's --keep and latest(live=); real_problems' live wiring (notes off, a folder per paid run, spend and failures however it ends); GatewayAdvisor.failures; scripts/model_paths --keep.

findings.defect: A costs question was asked again and again and the build waited on it.
findings.scenario: JD-05, JD-06, JD-08, JD-09 (HRN-022): costs asked four times; 'A question to the person is open (costs)'.
findings.cause: costs is a field the ask tool takes but no plan settles, so it was never known and never refused.
findings.fix: An optional field is closed by the person's reply (their words kept only when they name a cost), never asked twice, and does not count against the question limit.

findings.defect: A fraud walk was built without its entity, its folds not grouped by biker.
findings.scenario: RG-01, RG-02, JD-01: the model asked target, moment, labels, budget and offered to build.
findings.cause: Only the rules ask every field of the plan; a model's turn may end without one.
findings.fix: The coordinator asks a plan field never asked before the build (Facts.open_field, the step ask), and a model's turn that ends or offers to build with one open has it asked.

findings.defect: The model recorded the entity itself, as the row.
findings.scenario: 'Order (identified by order_id)', from the person's words 'the day's orders'; the group column became the row's own key.
findings.cause: A quote from the person's words was enough to record any plan field.
findings.fix: The entity only as the answer to its own question or the person's edit; an entity naming a key unique on every row groups nothing and is logged.

findings.defect: The model wrote the card's unit and the build stopped at the meet check.
findings.scenario: JD-01: 'unit: biker' from the answer 'The biker': 'Each prediction is for biker, but one row of the table is ...'.
findings.cause: The record tool accepted the unit with no check.
findings.fix: The unit is read by the rules only.

findings.defect: A question replied to stayed open behind the next one and was put to the person again.
findings.scenario: RG-02: the outcome question answered 'it is anomaly detection', the model asked about labels; the walk answered the outcome again.
findings.cause: pending() returns the first open question; nothing closed the one the person replied to.
findings.fix: A new question closes the one replied to; a plan field their words did not settle is superseded, so the plan asks it again.

findings.defect: The budget was recorded in the model's words and no review budget was read.
findings.scenario: RG-02: 'About 80 a day' became 'About 80 bikers reviewed per daily audit'; recall at the budget was never measured.
findings.cause: The record tool keeps the model's value for an answer.
findings.fix: A budget answer is kept in the person's words.

findings.defect: A question the person had answered was repeated word for word.
findings.scenario: RG-02 (run 5): 'A sample of the cases we found' answered the labels question; the model's turn ended in silence; the same question again (question_asked_again).
findings.cause: The silent-turn fallback re-said the open question whatever the person wrote.
findings.fix: A statement that answers the open question is taken as its answer; a question back still gets the plan and the question.

findings.defect: The harness kept no record of its live plays.
findings.scenario: HRN-022: only the summary; the drafts were in a temporary folder.
findings.cause: No keep folder passed to the plays.
findings.fix: --keep, by default a folder of its own per live run, each case's workspace, events and row kept.

findings.defect: The code gate read the failed live measurement.
findings.scenario: test_harness_gate failed on HRN-022 while the rules passed 17 of 17.
findings.cause: latest() was the newest run of any kind.
findings.fix: latest(live=False) for the gate and for stale().

findings.defect: The written person answered the outcome to the card's family question.
findings.scenario: JD-06: 'What should DCLab give for each row: a yes or no, a class, a number, a forecast...' matched the outcome's pattern on 'forecast'.
findings.cause: The person's reading of a question's meaning missed this wording.
findings.fix: The family's wording read before the outcome's.

findings.defect: Closing a replied question left a plan field unknown and never asked again.
findings.scenario: The entity said, not recorded, the model asked the budget: built without grouped folds.
findings.cause: The closed question still counted as asked.
findings.fix: Superseded for a plan field: asked again by the plan, not counted.

findings.defect: The person's own edit of the entity was refused.
findings.scenario: edit(did, 'entity', 'Each biker') returned the guard's error.
findings.cause: The edit goes through the same guard as the model.
findings.fix: The guard lets through the person's last edit of that field with those words.

findings.defect: A live real-problems run could spend outside its cap.
findings.scenario: Each stage's notes asked the installed gateway: no cap, not in the run's spend.
findings.cause: The team ran without the notes-off scope.
findings.fix: The walk and the team run inside notes_off.

findings.defect: Spend and failures were missing when a run stopped early, and failures counted the reader only.
findings.scenario: A paid run that stopped before the build recorded no spend.
findings.cause: The lines came after an early return.
findings.fix: _spent for every return, failures from the three advisors (GatewayAdvisor.failures).

findings.defect: A second live run the same day overwrote the first's records.
findings.scenario: The keep folder was per date only.
findings.cause: No time in its name.
findings.fix: A folder per run, with the time.

findings.defect: Code asked a second question over the model's own question that mentioned building.
findings.scenario: 'Before I build anything: how many alerts...?' then the labels question at once.
findings.cause: Any 'build' read as leave to build.
findings.fix: Only when every question of the reply is leave to build (and a pattern of the module that shadowed it renamed).

findings.defect: close_optional kept words that answered something else.
findings.scenario: Costs and entity asked in one reply; 'Each biker' kept as the cost.
findings.cause: Any reply recorded; the entity's answer refused for the first open question.
findings.fix: Costs kept only when a cost is named; notes appended; never after a simulation or a build; a record answers any open question of its field the person replied to.

findings.defect: The tests used a pack that does not exist.
findings.scenario: pack 'delivery' fell back to the base fields: entity never in the plan.
findings.cause: A wrong key.
findings.fix: The fraud pack imbalanced, the entity asserted asked and recorded.

findings.defect: An optional question took the place of a pack's last field.
findings.scenario: Costs counted against five questions, the fraud pack has five.
findings.cause: Every question counted.
findings.fix: counted(): never a superseded or an optional field's question.

findings.defect: A rerun deleted the earlier paid run's folder, and a refused run left the logs installed.
findings.scenario: rmtree of the same-day folder; SystemExit after the logs were installed.
findings.cause: Old code reached by live runs now.
findings.fix: A paid run's folder is never deleted; the logs installed after the last refusal.

measurements.name: the model paths, live
measurements.against_gate: synthetic, chat, parse, evidence and the intern each answered
limits: One request a path; made-up data.

measurements.name: the harness suite, live (HRN-022)
measurements.gate: 21.5's suite: every case right on every step and part
measurements.against_gate: the owner's morning cases wrong, and the journeys where a costs question looped or the entity was skipped
limits: The first live run; one seed; the written people.

measurements.name: reruns of the failed cases, live
measurements.gate: 21.5: every case right on every step and part
measurements.result: run 3: JD-05, JD-08, JD-09 right; run 4: RG-01, JD-06 right; run 5: JD-01 right, RG-01 and RG-02 right on every part, wrong on steps (RG-01 the questions in another order; RG-02 a question asked twice, fixed after)
measurements.against_gate: each rerun after a round of fixes
limits: Live models vary between runs; one seed.

measurements.name: the harness suite on the rules (HRN-023)
measurements.gate: 21.5: every case right on every step and part
measurements.against_gate: the fixes change nothing on the rules' path

outcome: The Home agent with the product's model now asks what changes the solution before a build, keeps the person's words where the rules read them, and never repeats a question the person answered; the suite keeps every live play.
lessons: A rule that holds only because the rules' own path always does it must be written as a guard the moment a model can take that path.
Where a model paraphrases an answer, keep the person's words wherever code reads a number or a column from them.
Read a live failure from its kept records before changing anything: four of the seven failures had the same few causes.
risks: RG-01 under a model asks the right questions in another order than the rules' exact expectation; the expectation stays as written.
Live results vary between runs; one seed and the written people.
